longSentence.title: 同位语从句 + 后置定语

data.en: The theory that human memory is not a single system but a collection of systems, each with its own rules, has been supported by decades of experiments.
data.zh: 人类记忆并非单一系统、而是一系列各自拥有规则的系统的集合——这一理论已得到数十年实验的支持。
points: 主干：The theory has been supported by decades of experiments。
that 引导同位语从句解释 theory 的内容。
each with its own rules 为独立主格作补充说明。

longSentence.title: 定语从句中套状语从句

data.en: Employees who feel their opinions are ignored are far more likely to leave the company when the job market improves.
data.zh: 当就业市场好转时，那些感到自己意见被忽视的员工离开公司的可能性要大得多。
points: 主干：Employees are far more likely to leave the company。
who 引导定语从句修饰 employees。
句末 when 引导时间状语从句，说明条件。

data.en: The proposal, though welcomed by many educators, has drawn sharp criticism from parents who worry about screen time.
data.zh: 尽管这一提案受到许多教育工作者欢迎，却招致了担心屏幕时间的家长们的尖锐批评。
points: 主干：The proposal has drawn sharp criticism from parents。
though welcomed by many educators 为插入的让步状语。
who 从句修饰 parents。

data.en: Faced with shrinking budgets, universities are cutting liberal-arts programs that once defined a well-rounded education.
data.zh: 面对不断缩减的预算，高校正在削减那些曾定义通识教育的文科项目。
points: 主干：universities are cutting liberal-arts programs。
Faced with… 为过去分词短语作原因状语，逻辑主语是 universities。
that 从句修饰 programs。

data.en: Not until the invention of the printing press did knowledge become widely available to ordinary people.
data.zh: 直到印刷术发明，知识才广泛地为普通民众所获得。
points: Not until… 置于句首引起部分倒装：did knowledge become。
主句正常语序应为 knowledge did not become… until…。
翻译时还原为直到…才…。

data.en: It is the quality of sleep, rather than its quantity, that determines how well we remember what we have learned.
data.zh: 决定我们对所学内容记忆好坏的是睡眠质量，而非睡眠时长。
points: It is … that … 为强调句型，被强调部分是 the quality of sleep。
rather than its quantity 为插入的对比成分。
how well we remember… 为宾语从句。

longSentence.title: 虚拟语气 + 目的状语

data.en: Had the company invested in renewable energy ten years ago, it would not have struggled so much to meet today's emission standards.
data.zh: 如果这家公司十年前就投资可再生能源，如今就不至于为达到排放标准而如此挣扎。
points: Had… done 为虚拟条件句倒装，等于 If the company had invested…。
主句 would not have struggled 表示与过去事实相反。
不定式 to meet… 表目的。

longSentence.title: 多重并列 + 定语从句

data.en: Cities that invest in public transport, that design streets for pedestrians rather than cars, and that protect their green spaces tend to be healthier and more prosperous.
data.zh: 那些投资公共交通、把街道设计给行人而非汽车、并保护绿地的城市，往往更健康、更繁荣。
points: 主干：Cities tend to be healthier and more prosperous。
三个 that 引导的并列定语从句共同修饰 cities。
rather than cars 表示对比取舍。

writingTemplate.title: 议论文（观点 / 现象类）· 最高频

structure: 引入现象 / 亮明观点（1 段）
正面论证，例证支撑（1–2 段）
让步与反驳，体现思辨（1 段）
总结建议，重申观点（1 段）
data.skeleton:
Paragraph 1: 【现象/话题】has become a hot topic in recent years. From my perspective, 【观点】.
Paragraph 2: To begin with, 【论点一】. For example, 【例证】. Besides, 【进一步说明】.
Paragraph 3: Admittedly, 【对方合理之处】. However, 【反驳/强调自己观点】.
Paragraph 4: In conclusion, 【重申观点】. It is high time that we 【建议】.
tips: 开头亮观点要快：前两句内让阅卷老师看到立场。
每段首句 = 主题句，先结论后例证。
让步段 Admittedly… However… 是加分项。
结尾两句收束：重申观点 + 行动建议，不引入新论点。

structure: 描述图表总体趋势（1 段）
解读趋势并分析原因（2–3 段）
data.skeleton:
Paragraph 1: As is clearly shown in the chart, 【总体趋势】. The figure for 【A】 rose sharply from 【数字】 to 【数字】, while 【B】 remained relatively stable.
Paragraph 2: Several factors may account for this phenomenon. To begin with, 【原因一】. Moreover, 【原因二】. Last but not least, 【原因三】.
Paragraph 3: Given the trend, it is reasonable to predict that 【展望】. Therefore, 【建议/措施】.
tips: 描述只占 1/3，重点在分析，别罗列所有数据。
抓最：最大、最小、上升最快、下降最明显。
趋势词：rise / increase / surge / decline / drop / level off / fluctuate。
原因至少两条，落到经济、科技、观念、政策等维度。

data.skeleton:
Dear 【称呼】,
I am writing to 【目的：apply for / complain about / express my thanks for / invite】. 【背景 1–2 句】.
To be specific, 【要点一】. In addition, 【要点二】. Furthermore, 【要点三】.
I would appreciate it if you could 【期待】. Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
tips: 开头第一句直接说明写信目的。
要点用 To be specific / In addition / Furthermore 串联。
注意语气得体：投诉信礼貌、感谢信真诚。
落款用 Li Ming 等中性名字，符合考试要求。

data.skeleton:
Paragraph 1: The saying 【引言】 highlights the importance of 【主题】. I strongly agree with it, because 【理由总述】.
Paragraph 2: History offers convincing examples. 【例一】. Likewise, 【例二】. These cases show that 【论证总结】.
Paragraph 3: As for us college students, 【联系自身】. Only by 【行动】 can we 【结果】.
Paragraph 4: In a word, 【引言】 reminds us that 【升华】.
tips: 先翻译 + 解释引言，证明读懂了题。
例子要具体并扣住引言核心词。
结尾用 Only by… can we… 或强调句收尾。

data.en: With the rapid development of society, 【话题】 has become an increasingly hot topic among the public.
data.zh: 随着社会的快速发展，……已成为公众日益关注的热点话题。

data.en: Recently, the issue of 【话题】 has aroused wide concern among the public.
data.zh: 近来，……问题引起了公众的广泛关注。

data.en: There is a growing tendency that 【现象】, which has triggered heated debate.
data.zh: ……的现象日益增长，引发了激烈讨论。

data.en: Nowadays, it is not uncommon to see that 【现象】.
data.zh: 如今，看到……的现象并不少见。

data.en: From my perspective / As far as I am concerned, 【观点】.
data.zh: 在我看来，……。

data.en: There is no denying that 【观点/事实】.
data.zh: 不可否认，……。

data.en: I am firmly convinced that 【观点】.
data.zh: 我坚信……。

data.en: It goes without saying that 【观点】.
data.zh: 不言而喻，……。

data.en: A case in point is that 【例证】.
data.zh: 一个恰当的例子是……。

data.en: Take 【例子】 as an example. It clearly shows that 【结论】.
data.zh: 以……为例，它清楚地表明……。

data.en: Nothing is more important than 【主题】, which 【定语从句】.
data.zh: 没有什么比……更重要。

data.en: The evidence is overwhelming that 【事实】.
data.zh: 证据充分表明……。

data.en: Admittedly, 【对方观点】. However, 【反驳】.
data.zh: 诚然……，然而……。

data.en: It is true that 【事实】, yet it does not follow that 【结论】.
data.zh: 诚然……，但这并不意味着……。

data.en: While 【让步】, 【强调】 should not be overlooked.
data.zh: 尽管……，但……不应被忽视。

data.en: Impressive as 【优点】 is, I believe 【观点】.
data.zh: 尽管……令人印象深刻，但我认为……。

data.en: In conclusion / To sum up, 【重申观点】.
data.zh: 总而言之，……。

data.en: It is high time that we took effective measures to 【解决】.
data.zh: 是时候采取有效措施来……了。

data.en: Only by 【行动】 can we 【结果】.
data.zh: 只有通过……，我们才能……。

data.en: Taking all these factors into consideration, we may reasonably conclude that 【结论】.
data.zh: 综合考虑以上因素，我们可以合理得出结论……。

data.en: It is our responsibility to 【行动】, for the benefit of both ourselves and future generations.
data.zh: 为了我们自己和子孙后代的利益，……是我们的责任。

data.en: As is clearly shown in the chart, 【总体趋势】.
data.zh: 如图所示，……。

data.en: The figure for 【A】 rose sharply from 【数字】 to 【数字】, while 【B】 remained stable.
data.zh: ……的数据从……急剧上升到……，而……保持稳定。

data.en: A variety of factors may account for this phenomenon.
data.zh: 多种因素可以解释这一现象。

data.en: Given the trend, it is reasonable to predict that 【展望】.
data.zh: 鉴于这一趋势，可以合理预测……。

data.en: I am writing to express my sincere thanks for 【事由】.
data.zh: 我写信是为了对……表达诚挚的感谢。

data.en: I would appreciate it if you could 【请求】.
data.zh: 如果您能……，我将不胜感激。

data.en: Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
data.zh: 如有任何问题，请随时与我联系。
